parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero based start index for pagination.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, page size.

parameters.name: thread_token
parameters.description: Optional thread token to filter by. Pass null to ignore this filter.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional thread type filter. Pass null to return all types.

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Optional sorting string to determine the order of the returned threads.

post.description: This method runs a new execution thread in the specified workspace. Execution threads are used to start, work with a browser instance. They can be manually continued with the continue_use_thread method or stopped with the stop_thread method.

parameters.name: threadToken
parameters.description: The unique token of the thread to continue (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

delete.description: This method can be used to stop an existing execution thread. Stopping a thread will also stop the associated browser instance, if it exists.

parameters.name: threadToken
parameters.description: The unique token of the thread to stop (required).
